fields.FIR_Description: On 2026-02-05 at roughly 13:05, it was reported that the complainant paid Rs. 75,000 as a processing fee for a promised loan that was never disbursed. Kishore Murugan approached Thoothukudi Port PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000326. The complaint refers to Murugan Babu, a person who arranged the contact, reachable on 9000000070. The account reference SYN-ACC-100032 was noted in connection with the payment. The complaint mentions Mathan Velan, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000147, in connection with the events. Items referenced in the complaint: mobile phone records.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Agent reportedly claimed a guaranteed approval and became unreachable.
fields.Keywords: loan fraud, processing fee, residential colony, mobile number, associate, suspect, afternoon, receiving account
